text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the cafeteria with Narita Brian 
to have a meal.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll go place the order.
choice_data_list: Have you made up your mind already?
Have you made up your mind already?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I made up my mind this morning to eat 
thick meat. I will accept nothing else.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ma'am, one extra-thick steak, please!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well now, what a coincidence, Brian. Never 
thought you'd order the exact same thing.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry. We've only got one 
extra-thick steak left~

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I ordered first. Give it to me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? What're you talking about, we 
finished at the same time, didn't we!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I decided on steak this morning. I'm not 
compromising.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
My mouth is totally set for steak too! I'm 
not backing down!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"If that's how it is, it's one-on-one! The 
winner gets the steak. How's that sound!?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch... It can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
As for what the match will be... Brian's 
Trainer, you decide fairly for us!!
choice_data_list:
Let's call off the match and do a 
different training menu instead?

Speed Showdown! Habanero Nikuman Eating 
Contest!
A battle of stamina! Dance FEVER!
A Test of Power! A Ruthless Menko Battle!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I told you I was in the mood for 
thick-cut meat. Were you not listening?
choice_data_list: Let's try a different meat dish.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
No good. I need that feeling of sinking my 
teeth in.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You mean you want it as thick as that 
"Mega Pork Cutlet Set"?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Tonkatsu... Hmm, not bad. Let's go with 
that."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's battle it out for the 
'Extra-Large Tonkatsu Set'!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Why? I'm giving up the steak. There's no 
point in doing this.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Ahh, right! I shouldn't have 
mentioned tonkatsu!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Daaamn it! I was all geared up for battle 
too!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian was thoroughly satisfied 
after eating a thick tonkatsu.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds interesting! No objections from 
you either, Brian, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're on...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, there's a crazy spicy habanero in 
here...! I can tell just from the smell 
how "deadly" it is!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll devour it before I even have time to 
taste the heat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hafu, hafu! *munch munch*! This is... so, 
s-spicyyy...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I shall... leave flavor behind!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-What the...? She's so fast! How can 
she chew at that speed!?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't think, don't feel! Chew it up and 
swallow it down!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'll take the steak. My apologies.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Did you really push for the win even at 
the cost of hurting your throat?!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you got me! That extra-thick steak 
is all yours!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite being battered and exhausted, 
Narita Brian dug into a massive, thick 
steak...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll devour it before I even have time to 
taste the heat!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *chomp chomp chomp chomp...* Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Too spicy!! Am I not fast enough!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, your hands have stopped! In 
that case, excuse me while I take the 
lead!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Feels like my tongue is on fire! Dammit... 
I can't take... any more of this...!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh! The parhait is all mine!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... If you're gonna eat steak, cool 
your mouth down first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Defeated in the contest, Narita Brian 
didn't get to have any steak...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, so it's not about crushing the 
opponent, it's a battle against myself!
choice_data_list:
It's kicking up dust, so let's move 
somewhere else.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... You really had to pick the most 
troublesome way, didn't you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, this looks like a good spot! Alright, 
give me the signal to start!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Brian! Let's dance until we're 
bone-dry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The curtain rose on a fierce battle over 
the steak......!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You look like you're pretty close 
to your limit. Why don't you just give 
up... !?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't be ridiculous. Everything up until 
now... was just the warm-up!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wha—are you serious...!? What kind of 
nerves of steel does she have?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'm... at my limit~~! I can't even lift a 
single finger anymore...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: All done? Then the meat is mine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved complete victory, Narita 
Brian savored an extra-thick steak to her 
heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ngh!! ......Wh-What is that!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: My body won't listen to me...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh, that was close for me too. 
Still, a win's a win!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant*... Damn it. ...Take it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian lost the dance battle, 
missing out on her steak.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I like that! Overpowering your opponent 
with sheer force, huh? The victor of this 
battle is the one truly worthy of the 
meat!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph, I'm not giving up the meat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's get started right away. 
The rules are standard "Okoshi"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Seiya!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Two at once, not bad. ...However!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: This ends with one strike!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
T-The blinkers went flying! It's like an 
eruption...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
There is no point in continuing any 
further. The match is decided.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, that was quite a show! An 
extra-thick steak is totally fitting for 
you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian got to savor an extra-thick 
steak while basking in the afterglow of 
her victory!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You've got the spirit, but... it hasn't 
budged an inch. Put more muscle into it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch... It's not going well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times she tried, the 
menko card wouldn't flip, and Narita Brian 
suffered defeat.
